column1: # libreoffice build bf6ef2662401 on windows — document, line, drift below the page (pt), drift right of the page (pt), wider than the page (pt), letters

# every row shot whole on this build when the gate came to hold each line to its width, which the column before the letters records, two runs giving every line the same width to the hundredth. The export it measures is byte for byte the one before that change, and the rewrite moves lines of the 16 documents this file had gone stale in and of no other. The seven sidebar CVs (cv-charcoal_gold, cv-midnight_navy, cv-monogram_sidebar, cv-navy_sidebar, cv-professional_sidebar, cv-sidebar_portrait, cv-slate_orange): 487 lines 2.50 to 3.60pt lower, every line found, their section of one page drawing its page backgrounds from its header again, as LibreOffice 24.2's rows already stand. Eight documents moved nearer the page: 226 lines across in invoice-classic, invoice-classic_long, invoice-modern, invoice-modern_long, proposal-modern and cv-charcoal_gold, one of the seven above, by 0.85 to 1.05pt, and three down in cv-teal_pulse and cv-terracotta_rail, by 0.55 and 0.60pt. Two moved further, and what moved them is not found: invoice-obsidian and proposal-indigo, which this file held on 1 page and LibreOffice now sets on 2, losing 5 and 3 lines and setting 14 and 51 of the rest 1.20 to 5.60pt and 1.10 to 10.25pt lower than it held them. The rows it held for them are in this file's history. Other documents' medians and p90s move with lines that stay within half a point
